capabilities: Chat with an AI agent that reads and writes notes through tools
Require human approval for agent write operations via a policy chain
Create, iterate and reload Cordis sub-plugins through conversation
Configure OpenAI-compatible model providers with per-model defaults
Export chat sessions to Markdown in a configurable directory
disambiguation: Its sub-plugins are Cordis plugins adapted to Obsidian's extension points, not Obsidian-native community plugins.
extras: Desktop only (no Obsidian Mobile support); status is beta; API keys are stored in plain text in .obsidian/plugins/harness-like/data.json; full user and developer docs live on an external Harness Like Docs site.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian implementation inspired by DeepSeek Harness
problem: Obsidian plugins are static, hand-coded extensions; there is no built-in way to run an AI agent over your notes or generate new plugins by chatting.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian implementation inspired by DeepSeek Harness
It embeds a Cordis runtime inside the Obsidian plugin process

summary: AI agent plugin that embeds a Cordis runtime in Obsidian, letting an agent read and write notes, call tools with approval, and build sub-plugins by conversation.
